scientific_question: Does compact-v2 SUCCESS rescue transfer from the four H0 tasks to unseen tasks, or is the remaining gap a state-distribution problem?
hypothesis: If compact-v2 fixes only output formatting, held-out tasks should become valid but remain near-zero reward; non-zero held-out reward would support broader policy rescue.

frozen_variables.runtime: pinned JDK/HF cache and one UUID-bound process per cell

cell_design: 3 arms x 2 held-out partitions = 6 cells; 4 tasks x 4 fresh seeds = 16 attempts per cell; 96 total

stop_branch.heldout_rescue: SUCCESS >=12/16 valid in each partition and >=2 qualified positives overall: proceed to held-out residual/state test; D0 remains closed
stop_branch.valid_only: SUCCESS valid >=12/16 but qualified positives <2: classify as contract-only rescue and diagnose state distribution
stop_branch.no_transfer: SUCCESS valid <12/16: preserve negative transfer evidence; do not change adapter rank/LR/epochs
stop_branch.runtime_failure: exclude artifacts and open a separate repair group

claim_boundary: Held-out transfer/state-distribution diagnostic; no benchmark claim, no D0 opening, no SEED comparison.

result.classification: contract-only rescue; no held-out reward transfer
